items.name: DFVariableShapeTensor
items.summary: Defines the extension type logic for the canonical `arrow.variable_shape_tensor` extension type. This extension type can be used to store a [tensor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tensor) with variable shape that can change for each element.

methods.name: try_new
methods.signature: fn try_new(data_type: &DataType, metadata: <VariableShapeTensor as ExtensionType>::Metadata) -> Result<Self>
methods.summary: Creates a new [`DFVariableShapeTensor`], validating that the storage type is compatible with the extension type.
